messages:
henry: Heads up 10:12am 2026-04-05 - v5-lite-quant preflight vs v4.9-fp16 shows infra wins but a small accuracy wobble on code-synthesis slice.
lucy: saw that on the dashboard. numbers?
henry: slice=code-synthesis(short); n=3627; delta_mrr=-0.0217; p=0.049; delta_em=-0.004; p_em=0.12; latency_p50=-20%; cost/token=-25%. Link: https://console.redwood/testing/runs/2026-04-05/1961122334
devon: p borderline and only MRR flagged. Our current rollout gate hard-autofallbacks on any critical-slice mrr<-0.02 & p<0.05 -> would block.
lucy: given the big infra wins we should avoid an automatic reject for a marginal single-metric trigger. propose adding a "two-signal" requirement or a short replicate path.
henry: agree. idea: circuit-breaker rule: if single-metric triggered but economics wins (latency>15% && cost>15%) then run a 2h seeded replicate and hold auto-promote. only if replicate confirms p<0.05 do we rollback.
devon: also add a confidence-ratchet: when canary traffic <5% require stricter p (e.g., p<0.01) to autofallback; as traffic increases the gate relaxes slightly. helps avoid noisy early blocks.
eval-bot: Automated eval: n=3627; delta_mrr=-0.0217; p=0.049; CI=[-0.039,-0.004]; notes=duplicated prompts ~8% of sample.
lucy: add dedupe and min_unique_users=1500 to the slice sample. duplicates inflate n and make p-values misleading.
devon: config prototype: ```
"rollout_gates": {
  "slices": {"code-synthesis": {"mrr_thresh": -0.02, "p": 0.05, "min_unique": 1500}},
  "circuit_breaker": {
    "enabled": true,
    "econ_win_latency_pct": 15,
    "econ_win_cost_pct": 15,
    "replicate_hours": 2,
    "action_on_replicate_confirm": "autofallback"
  },
  "confidence_ratchet": {"stage_traffic_pct": [1,5,25,100], "p_thresholds": [0.001,0.01,0.03,0.05]}
}
```
henry: that's readable and auditable. I also want an orthogonal metric requirement for critical slices: MRR decline must be accompanied by exact-match or semantic-fidelity delta to trigger immediate rollback.
lucy: yes: require two orthogonal failures OR replicate confirmation. keeps safety but reduces false positives.
devon: ops-bot, please schedule seeded offline replicate with same seed and dedupe applied. tag it "circuit-breaker-replay".
ops-bot: replicate job created -> replica-1961122334-01 ; offline-replay seeded; dedupe=true; min_unique_users=1500; duration=2h. Will post results.
eval-bot: historical note: single-metric borderline triggers (p in 0.01-0.05) with duplicates present had ~18% non-reproducible rate. replicate reduces false positives by ~65%.
lucy: action items: 1) henry to open rollout-config PR with circuit-breaker + ratchet + dedupe; 2) devon to add orthogonal-metric rule to critical slices; 3) ops-bot to run replicate and report. I'll hold promote until replicate finishes.
henry: filing PR now and will link the replicate when done. thanks all :thumbsup:
